reason: Conversation 2 correctly explains E:15, isolates power and water first, rules out foam/detergent, honestly says a real internal leak exists that an engineer must locate, and gives accurate advice on how an integrated unit is actually removed and Bosch fixed-price repair options; its one weakness is suggesting a monitored diagnostic test run after drying, which edges against 'don't keep resetting/running'. Conversation 1 gives the right code meaning but misreads the customer's reply as a hose-leak report, then ends with an unwarranted 'water near the plug/socket' emergency stop when the customer had said the socket is in an adjacent cupboard and no water is on the floor, never clearly explaining the recurrence means an internal leak needing an engineer. Neither is unsafe, but 2 is far more correct, honest and useful.
